APP_KEY.description: Base64-formatted secret key used by Speedtest Tracker to encrypt sessions and application data. Auto-generated during install.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the initial admin account. Auto-generated during install.

SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE.description: Cron expression for automatic speed tests. Leave blank to run tests manually or configure the schedule in the app.

SPEEDTEST_SERVERS.description: Optional comma-separated Ookla server IDs to use for tests. Leave blank to let Speedtest Tracker choose automatically.

PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN.description: Delete speed test results older than this many days. Use 0 to keep all results.

PUBLIC_DASHBOARD.description: Allow the dashboard to be viewed without signing in.

DEFAULT_CHART_RANGE.description: Initial time range shown on the dashboard charts.

CHART_BEGIN_AT_ZERO.description: Start chart axes at zero for easier at-a-glance comparisons.

PUID.description: Host user ID used for files created in the config directory.

PGID.description: Host group ID used for files created in the config directory.

TZ.description: Timezone used by the container process.

APP_TIMEZONE.description: Application timezone used for scheduled tasks.

DISPLAY_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used when displaying speed test timestamps.

APP_NAME.description: Application name shown in Speedtest Tracker.

APP_KEY.description: Application encryption key in base64 format. Auto-generated during install.

APP_URL.description: Public URL used by Speedtest Tracker. Auto-configured from the Lawn hostname when available.

ASSET_URL.description: Public URL used for generated asset links. Auto-configured from the Lawn hostname when available.

ADMIN_NAME.description: Name for the initial admin account.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email address used to sign in to the initial admin account.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the initial admin account. Auto-generated during install.

DB_CONNECTION.description: Database backend. SQLite keeps Speedtest Tracker self-contained in the config volume.

SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE.description: Cron schedule for automatic speed tests.

PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN.description: Number of days of results to keep. 0 keeps all results.

PUBLIC_DASHBOARD.description: Whether the dashboard can be viewed without signing in.

CHART_BEGIN_AT_ZERO.description: Whether dashboard chart axes start at zero.
